items.source_en:
Vessel sustained severe structural and systems damage during retreat from Rebel engagement. Starboard hull compromised across multiple decks, with containment fields holding against decompression. Primary shield generators are operating at approximately 47 percent efficiency and fluctuating under load. Port turbolaser batteries destroyed. Hyperdrive motivator functioning at unstable output after emergency jump. Reactor fluctuations remain within survival parameters but are not combat-capable.

Engine output reduced to 58 percent. Long-range communications array disabled. Multiple emergency relay beacons have been deployed, but no confirmation signal has been received. Medical and damage control teams are operating under emergency conditions. The cruiser requires immediate drydock repair and full systems overhaul before it can be returned to fleet readiness.
